description: Emergency stop for the whole account: cancel every resting order, close every position on every exchange with reduce-only orders, and block new positions. Use only when the person asks to stop everything or something is clearly wrong. Only the person can resume, with an authenticator code on the Web or in Telegram; agents keep their status but cannot open until then. Third-party apps never get this permission. Not for closing one position (use close_position). Input: reason. Next: get_my_positions to confirm nothing is left.

reason.description: Why, for the user and the audit log

name: stop_all_trading

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

halted.description: Always true: new positions are blocked until the person resumes (authenticator code, on the Web or in Telegram); agents keep their status

ok.description: True when nothing is left open

receipt.description: Signed receipt (compact JWS, EdDSA); verify with /.well-known/tradehub-receipts.jwks

remaining.description: Anything that could not be closed; retry or close it by hand

title: Stop all trading now
